articles.title: The least surprising chapter of the Manus story is what’s happening right now
articles.summary: Did anyone think there would not be a reckoning over this tie-up?

articles.title: Mercor competitor Deccan AI raises $25M, sources experts from India
articles.summary: Deccan AI concentrates its workforce in India to manage quality in a fast-growing but fragmented AI training market.

articles.title: The AI skills gap is here, says AI company, and power users are pulling ahead
articles.summary: Anthropic finds AI isn’t replacing jobs yet, but early data shows growing inequality as experienced users gain an edge, raising concerns about future displacement and workforce divides.

articles.title: Google unveils TurboQuant, a new AI memory compression algorithm — and yes, the internet is calling it ‘Pied Piper’
articles.summary: Google’s TurboQuant has the internet joking about Pied Piper from HBO's "Silicon Valley." The compression algorithm promises to shrink AI’s “working memory” by up to 6x, but it’s still just a lab experiment for now.

articles.title: Melania Trump wants a robot to homeschool your child
articles.summary: The first lady sees AI and robotics playing a prominent role in the future of American education.

articles.title: Bernie Sanders and AOC propose a ban on data center construction
articles.summary: Senator Bernie Sanders and Rep. Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez introduced companion legislation to halt construction on new data centers until Congress passes comprehensive AI regulation.

articles.title: Google launches Lyria 3 Pro music generation model
articles.summary: Google is launching Lyria 3 Pro, an upgraded music model that generates longer, more customizable tracks, as it expands AI music tools across Gemini, enterprise products, and other services.

articles.title: Reddit takes on the bots with new ‘human verification’ requirements for fishy behavior
articles.summary: Reddit will require suspected automated accounts to verify they’re human, as it ramps up efforts to curb bot-driven spam and manipulation.

articles.title: Harvey confirms $11B valuation: Sequoia triples down
articles.summary: Investors like Sequoia, Andreessen Horowitz, Kleiner Perkins, and Elad Gil can't get enough of AI legal tech startup Harvey.

articles.title: Granola raises $125M, hits $1.5B valuation as it expands from meeting notetaker to enterprise AI app
articles.summary: Granola's valuation jumped from $250 million to $1.5 billion with this round, and it has added more support for AI agents after users previously complained.

articles.title: Meta launches new initiative to support entrepreneurship, drive AI adoption
articles.summary: Meta CEO Mark Zuckerberg said in a memo to staff that small businesses have always been a big part of the company's business model, and that while tens of millions of entrepreneurs already use its platforms to grow and connect with customers, the company wants to do more in the space.

articles.title: Meta turns to AI to make shopping easier on Instagram and Facebook
articles.summary: Meta is using generative AI to provide more product and brand information to consumers when they're shopping in its apps.

articles.title: With Sift, two ex-SpaceX engineers are bringing the software that helped launch rockets to the factory floor
articles.summary: Sift is building the data infrastructure for advanced manufacturing.

articles.title: Lucid Bots raises $20M to keep up with demand for its window-washing drones
articles.summary: Lucid Bots has seen demand accelerate over the last year for its window-cleaning drones and power-washing robots.

articles.title: With $3.5B in fresh capital, Kleiner Perkins is going all in on AI
articles.summary: The fundraise includes $1 billion for investing in early-stage startups and $2.5 billion for late-stage growth businesses.

articles.title: OpenAI’s Sora was the creepiest app on your phone — now it’s shutting down
articles.summary: Though the underlying Sora 2 video- and audio-generation model is scarily impressive, there was not sustained interest in an AI-only social feed.

articles.title: Kentucky woman rejects $26M offer to turn her farm into a data center
articles.summary: A "major artificial intelligence company" reportedly offered a Kentucky family $26 million to build a data center on their farm.

articles.title: Anthropic hands Claude Code more control, but keeps it on a leash
articles.summary: Anthropic’s new auto mode for Claude Code lets AI execute tasks with fewer approvals, reflecting a broader shift toward more autonomous tools that balance speed with safety through built-in safeguards.

articles.title: Spotify tests new tool to stop AI slop from being attributed to real artists
articles.summary: The idea behind the new tool is to give artists more control over which tracks are associated with their name on Spotify.

articles.title: Databricks bought two startups to underpin its new AI security product
articles.summary: With an overflowing war chest from its recent $5 billion raise, Databricks is buying startups and looking for more. It acquired Antimatter and SiftD.ai.

articles.title: Proposal to turn warehouse into data center approved by local authorities near Allentown, Pennsylvania
articles.summary: Logistics company Prologis already owns the warehouse

articles.title: Distributed power delivery firm Scalvy raises $13.9 million in Series A round
articles.summary: Startup claims its modular power conversion architecture results in data center power savings

articles.title: Bell Canada and Buzz HPC expand partnership for sovereign AI in Merritt, Canada
articles.summary: Buzz secures initial 6.5MW of capacity at Bell data center

articles.title: Vertiv acquires data center cooling firm ThermoKey
articles.summary: Vertiv expands portfolio with dry coolers and microchannel heat exchangers

articles.title: Sponsored: Overcoming the challenges of data center cooling
articles.summary: With the right cooling system and monitoring technology in place to manage and optimize its performance, operators can reduce energy costs and water consumption

articles.title: Sponsored: Managing AI workloads with advanced UPS controls
articles.summary: By implementing advanced controls, datacenter operators can bring greater stability and performance levels to high-performance computing environments

articles.title: Telesat adds military Ka-Band to Lightspeed constellation, following defense demands
articles.summary: Lightspeed further aligns to defense needs following recent contracts, as GEO business atrophies

articles.title: Why the next infrastructure bill should include data centers
articles.summary: Policymakers must take note

articles.title: Ericsson taps Europe's fastest supercomputer to fuel AI development for 6G
articles.summary: Jupiter to train large-scale AI models for Ericsson’s next-gen RAN offerings

articles.title: Germany's Maincubes breaks ground on second Berlin data center campus
articles.summary: Work starts on BER02 site, first phase due live next year

articles.title: AI chip startup Epic Microsystems raises $21m for development of power delivery systems
articles.summary: Round with led by Seligman Ventures and saw participation from Intel Capital

articles.title: HostDime suffers downtime at UK data center due to contractual dispute with colocation provider
articles.summary: Brings down HostDime customer workloads as well

articles.title: Singapore real estate investment firm RealVantage invests in Minnesota data center
articles.summary: Company invests in Minneapolis facility recently acquired by Cloud Capital and Arcapita

articles.title: Fastweb+Vodafone terminates Inwit tower agreement
articles.summary: Follows the company's recently announced Italian tower JV with Telecom Italia

articles.title: Cipher Digital secures hyperscale tenant under 15-year lease
articles.summary: Cipher also secures revolving credit facility of up to $200m

articles.title: Poland’s Ministry of Digital Affairs funds $8.1m AI supercomputer at NASK research institute
articles.summary: Nvidia-powered system will be available to government and enterprises

articles.title: UK altnet G.Network emerges from administration following restructuring
articles.summary: Fiber firm is now debt-free

articles.title: Google expands quantum roadmap to include neutral atoms as well as superconducting qubits
articles.summary: Google says focusing on second modality with increase its ability to deliver mission sooner

articles.title: Michigan, New York lawmakers consider virtual power plant bills
articles.summary: The proposals would prohibit utility ownership of participating distributed energy resources and require reasonable access for third-party aggregators.

articles.title: Data center buildouts slowed late last year
articles.summary: “Power and electrical equipment is still the main driver of construction delays,” said Gordon Dolven, CBRE data center research director.

articles.title: Solar and wind hit a record 17% of U.S. generation in 2025: EIA
articles.summary: “Combining utility-scale and small-scale solar generation in 2025 increases the share of wind and solar to 19% of total net generation,” said the Energy Information Administration.

articles.title: PJM’s crisis has a simple solution: Copy what works in regulated states
articles.summary: The competitive market was supposed to produce lower prices, but when faced with the first big demand shock in decades, it delivered chaos, writes Power for Tomorrow President Brad Viator.

articles.title: Pepco Holdings CEO talks rising demand, affordability and PJM market reforms
articles.summary: Adding power supplies in PJM — including utility-owned generation — is one way to address affordability challenges, says Pepco Holdings CEO Tyler Anthony.

articles.title: Puget Sound’s vehicle-to-home charging pilot combines demand response, peak shaving, resilience
articles.summary: The test will use electric vehicle batteries for demand response and residential peak shaving while also making their storage capacity available during power outages.

articles.title: DOE extends emergency operations at 2 Indiana coal plants
articles.summary: Since December the plants “have proven critical” to operations in the Midcontinent ISO region, DOE said. Sierra Club says they cost consumers almost $200,000 per day.

articles.title: Utilities must ask AI vendors these questions to meet critical infrastructure protection standards
articles.summary: Utilities deploying AI tools may be creating a compliance gap that will become visible only when auditors start asking questions, writes Eric Swidey, founder of Thirty Seven Inc.

articles.title: NextEra to develop 9.5 GW of gas in Texas, Pennsylvania
articles.summary: The projects are part of a $550 billion deal with Japan that also includes 3 GW of nuclear in Tennessee and Alabama and 9.2 GW of gas generation in Ohio, federal officials say.

articles.title: Maryland ratepayer advocate calls for greater transmission oversight as costs rise
articles.summary: Costs to customers in the state could reach $5.4 billion for transmission built from 2031 through 2035, compared with $7.1 billion spread over the previous 20 years, according to the advocate.

articles.title: German energy minister calls nuclear phase-out 'huge mistake'
articles.summary: Katherina Reiche, Germany's economy and energy minister, discussed the likely impact on the country's economy if the Iran conflict continues - as well as the need for a "correction" to energy policies in Europe, at a conference in the USA.

articles.title: Second tier installed for Leningrad inner containment building
articles.summary: The installation of the second tier at Leningrad Nuclear Power Plant's seventh unit means the inner containment building has now reached a height of 22 metres.

articles.title: Arup to support delivery of the UK's first SMR
articles.summary: Multinational professional services firm Arup has been appointed by Great British Energy - Nuclear to provide early-phase foundation engineering and design support for the construction of its small modular reactor project at Wylfa on the island of Anglesey, North Wales.

articles.title: First San'ao unit connected to the grid
articles.summary: Unit 1 of the San'ao nuclear power plant has begun supplying electricity to the grid for the first time, China General Nuclear announced. The unit is the first of six Hualong One (HPR1000) reactors planned for the site in Zhejiang province.

articles.title: First new Kursk unit reaches full power
articles.summary: The first VVER-TOI unit at the Kursk II Nuclear Power Plant in Russia has had its power increased to 100% as its commissioning process continues.

articles.title: Planning for Swedish SMR plant proceeds
articles.summary: Swedish lead-cooled small modular reactor technology developer Blykalla said it plans to proceed with the next phase of planning for a power plant in Norrsundet, Gävle, in east central Sweden, after initial assessments confirmed that the site offers suitable conditions.

articles.title: X-energy, Talen to assess deployment of multiple SMR plants
articles.summary: US advanced nuclear technology developer X-energy Reactor Company has signed a Letter of Intent with Talen Energy Corporation to assess deploying X-energy's XE-100 small modular reactors in Pennsylvania and across the PJM Interconnection Regional Transmission Organization market.

articles.title: Aalo completes assembly of experimental reactor
articles.summary: Aalo Atomics has held a ceremony to unveil its completed Critical Test Reactor at the Idaho National Laboratory. The company said it expects the reactor to achieve criticality "well before" the 4 July deadline.

articles.title: Early construction landmarks for Chinese units
articles.summary: The giant CA20 structural module of Bailong nuclear power plant's unit 1 has been lifted into place - and the first steam generator moved into position at Lufeng nuclear power plant's unit 6.

articles.title: Vietnam, Russia sign agreement on new nuclear plant
articles.summary: An intergovernmental agreement has been signed on cooperation in the construction of the Ninh Thuan 1 Nuclear Power Plant in Vietnam, to feature two VVER‑1200 reactors, with the new Leningrad units as the reference project.

articles.title: Application submitted for Swedish SMR plant
articles.summary: Kärnfull Next has submitted an application to build a power plant based on small modular reactors in the municipality of Valdemarsvik in Östergötland county in southeastern Sweden. It is the first application under the country’s new Act on Government Approval of Nuclear Facilities.

articles.title: Uzbekistan and Russia mark SMR construction progress
articles.summary: Russia and Uzbekistan have signed a roadmap for nuclear cooperation, as initial concrete was poured as part of preparations for the construction of the first small modular reactor at Uzbekistan’s first nuclear power plant.

articles.title: IAEA and Russia discuss Zaporizhzhia nuclear plant situation
articles.summary: International Atomic Energy Agency Director General Rafael Mariano Grossi described the talks with Rosatom Director General Alexei Likhachev in Moscow as "comprehensive and timely".

articles.title: UK implementing nuclear regulatory review recommendations
articles.summary: Three months on from the publication of the final report of the Nuclear Regulatory Taskforce, the UK government has outlined its plans to speed up nuclear delivery. All reforms are expected to be completed by the end of next year, subject to legislative timelines.

articles.title: Regulatory justification for Rolls‑Royce SMR
articles.summary: UK Secretary of State for Environment, Food and Rural Affairs, Emma Reynolds, has decided to provide regulatory justification for the Rolls‑Royce SMR design - the first small modular reactor to receive this approval.

articles.title: APS to seek fresh Palo Verde life extension
articles.summary: Arizona Public Service has officially informed the US Nuclear Regulatory Commission that it wants to renew the operating licences for the Palo Verde Generating Station for a further 20 years.

articles.title: 'Projectile' hit 350 metres from Bushehr nuclear reactor - IAEA
articles.summary: The International Atomic Energy Agency has said that "following information from Iran of a projectile incident on Tuesday evening, the IAEA can confirm that a structure 350 metres from the Bushehr NPP reactor was hit and destroyed".

articles.title: Poland’s radioactive waste management reviewed by IAEA mission
articles.summary: An International Atomic Energy Agency team of experts has praised progress made by Poland in safely managing its radioactive waste, and recommended further steps as the country moves ahead with its nuclear power programme.

articles.title: Licensing of Oklo pilot reactor facilities advances
articles.summary: Nuclear technology company Oklo has received US Department of Energy approval for the Nuclear Safety Design Agreements for both its first Aurora powerhouse at Idaho National Laboratory and Atomic Alchemy's Groves Isotopes Test Reactor in Texas. Atomic Alchemy has also been granted a materials licence for the isotope reactor.

articles.title: Work begins on solar power supply at Chernobyl
articles.summary: Preparatory work has begun for installing solar panels which the operators of the Chernobyl plant site say will help meet energy needs if external power is lost.
